format: machinist posting with duty lines: 'as required', 'desired tolerances', 'must be able to lift'
note: 'as required' and 'desired tolerances' never bind (R2.4): hydraulics and 5S stay unscored in Job Duties; 'interpret GD&T to hold desired tolerances' stays required (section); 'Update SPC charts as required' stays preferred (section). 'Must be able to lift' has no skill and binds nothing (R2.8.10). The title line mentions CNC and has no colon, so it is body text (R2.8.7), pre-heading unknown; CNC wins required later and its evidence is the Qualifications line. FANUC appears only in Benefits: excluded, and the resume's FANUC is not found. Resume: Fusion 360 really negated; 'with zero scrap' and 'without supervisor sign-off delays' are not negations.
posting_text:
CNC Machinist II - 2nd Shift
Ridgeline Precision, Rockford, IL

Job Duties
- Set up and operate CNC lathes and mills for aerospace brackets
- Maintain hydraulics and coolant systems on assigned machines as required
- Lead 5S audits on the cell as required
- Complete first-article and in-process inspections per AS9100 procedures
- Must be able to lift 50 lbs and stand for a full 10-hour shift

Qualifications
- 3+ years of CNC machining experience
- Ability to read blueprints and interpret GD&T to hold desired tolerances
- High school diploma or GED

Preferred
- Experience with Mastercam or Fusion 360
- Update SPC charts as required

Benefits
- Shift differential, overtime, and 401(k) with match
- Paid training on our new FANUC robot loading cell
